notes.title: Seccond update for The Week With Grugles 2
notes.content:
[p][b]Hey everyone! The Week With Grugles 2 just got another update![/b]

Here's some of the stuff that got added:

Bug Fixes:

 Fixed the power draining too quick and making it impossible to get past night 3

New Features:

 Added an indicator when you run out of power, now the room gets dark and there is a sound that plays 
[i](I should have had it there at launch but forgot to make the code actually execute lol)[/i]

[i]If there are any issues please submit them to the [url="https://forms.gle/2PgyGQnfUqfnvXQg8"]feedback forum[/url], (this forum is for all bugs and feedback by the way)[/i]
[b]
I hope you guys enjoy the game![/b][/p]

P.S. I want to apologize for how long this patch took to release, I moved recently and have not had access to my computer in a hot minute. Thank you all for your patience, and I hope you can properly enjoy the game now!

notes.title: First update for The Week With Grugles 2
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone! The Week With Grugles 2 just received its first update![/b]

Here's some of the stuff that got added:

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed the phone calls occasionally playing the unfiltered version
[/list]

New Features:
[list]
[*] Made nights slightly longer, they were going by too fast, so I made them last a little longer.
[*] Made it so that the toggle for controllers is also a button that can be clicked in case a controller is not connected
[*] Added more languages!
[/list]

Languages:
Added 3 new languages
[list]
[*] Spanish
[*] Polish
[*] German
[/list]
[i]Just like with the update for the first game, I used Google Translate for most of the languages added, so the grammar might be a little poor. If there are any issues please submit them to the [url=https://forms.gle/2PgyGQnfUqfnvXQg8]feedback forum[/url], (this forum is for all bugs and feedback by the way)[/i]
[b]
I hope you guys enjoy the game![/b]
